recipe.name: Gale Needle
recipe.description: A fencing blade machined to an impossible point, humming faintly when drawn.

recipe.name: Flash Rapier
recipe.description: Forged thin as a reed by duelists who prized speed above all.

recipe.name: Enduring Robe
recipe.description: Plate that has outlasted the wars it was made for, and the smith who made it.

recipe.name: Survivor's Robe
recipe.description: Field plate patched and repatched by those who lived to patch it.

recipe.name: Bog Eye
recipe.description: A bog-touched eye that drinks deep and gives quietly back.

recipe.name: Murk Eye
recipe.description: A preserved golem eye, still weeping faint green light.

recipe.name: Mountain Stride
recipe.description: Forged for those who treat a sheer slope as a road.

recipe.name: Iron Treads
recipe.description: Heavy soles that bite into scree and loose rock alike.

recipe.name: Tempered Core
recipe.description: Balanced for any hand. It asks no commitment, and rewards none in particular.

recipe.name: Quake Hammer
recipe.description: When it lands, the ground remembers it longer than the foe does.

recipe.name: Heavy Hammer
recipe.description: Two-handed, brutal, and honest. It asks only that you find the time to swing it.

recipe.name: Ruinous Axe
recipe.description: Bigger, meaner, and somehow better balanced — chaos with the faintest thread of discipline.

recipe.name: Chaotic Axe
recipe.description: A wild, top-heavy thing that fights as much as it is wielded.

recipe.name: Bog Wrappings
recipe.description: Cloth drawn from the deepest mire, where even the water has forgotten the sun.

recipe.name: Arcane Wrappings
recipe.description: Marsh-cloth steeped in old wardings against rot and fume.

recipe.name: Sand Sprint
recipe.description: Wide and light, made to outpace a storm across open dune.

recipe.name: Stinger Rapier
recipe.description: A thin blade kept slick with something the jungle distilled and never named.

recipe.name: Iron Crusader Plate
recipe.description: Masterwork plate of the old crusades, dented in a hundred places, breached in none.

recipe.name: Fallen Knight Plate
recipe.description: Stripped from a knight who fell at the high pass and was never named.

recipe.name: Iron Bulwark
recipe.description: A ward-stone the mountainfolk pass down, hand to weathered hand.

recipe.name: Granite Barrier
recipe.description: A palm of carved granite, cold and patient as the peak it came from.

recipe.name: Cavern Sprints
recipe.description: Worn smooth on tunnel floors no map has ever charted.

recipe.name: Bat Wing Boots
recipe.description: Stretched membrane that falls on stone without a whisper.

recipe.name: Dire Bestial Hide
recipe.description: From a beast the deep-cavern folk name only in low voices.

recipe.name: Bestial Hide
recipe.description: The hide of something large and unlucky, cured to a stubborn toughness.

recipe.name: Survivalist Core
recipe.description: Wound-knit heartwood. It does not stop the blow — it shortens the time you spend regretting it.

recipe.name: Knight's Steelsword
recipe.description: A knight sidearm kept keen by habit and pride — plain, proven, never flashy.

recipe.name: Iron Broadsword
recipe.description: Mass-forged for the ranks, dependable as sunrise. Ten thousand like it have won quiet wars.

recipe.name: Verdant Weave
recipe.description: A living mesh of leaf and creeper, too quick and too giving to be struck square.

recipe.name: Venom Knife
recipe.description: The venom runs deeper now; what it touches keeps rotting.

recipe.name: Poison Dagger
recipe.description: A short blade kept slick with mire-venom that refuses to dry.
